assumptions_challenged: Assumption that citing MISEV2023 alone is sufficient to demonstrate SGL-001 meets or fails specific CMC/analytics gating criteria
Assumption that SGL-001 currently lacks MCB/WCB documentation (this is asserted but not evidenced in the supplied record)
Assumption that intact-EV orthogonal QC assays have been fit-for-purpose validated (LLOQ, specificity, precision) for the program
Assumption that a stability-indicating potency assay linked to an in vivo PD endpoint already exists for SGL-001
Assumption that 6 GMP-like bridging batches with release/stability/potency data have been produced and documented
Assumption that the proposed ~3-month timeline is feasible given unknown current development/resourcing status and without presented parallelization evidence
falsification_conditions: Provision of MCB and WCB characterization and documentation (cell bank certificates, genetic/phenotypic identity, mycoplasma/sterility/viral safety testing, storage records) for SGL-001 source cells

Submission of fit-for-purpose validation reports for the orthogonal intact-EV QC panel demonstrating LLOQ, specificity (distinguishing EVs from non-vesicular particles), accuracy, precision (intra/inter-assay), and robustness for particle count and marker assays

Provision of a validated stability-indicating potency assay report linked quantitatively to an in vivo PD endpoint (study protocol, raw and analyzed data showing assay readout correlates with biologic effect)

Release, stability, and potency reports for 6 GMP-like bridging batches (batch records, release test results, stability timepoints, comparability statistics) demonstrating reproducible identity/potency across lots
Formulation and device compatibility study reports demonstrating intact-EV recovery and acceptable potency/identity post-fill/dispense (methods, recovery metrics, acceptance criteria)

GLP-like large-animal intranasal biodistribution/toxicity study report using the validated intact-EV assays, with appropriate controls and assay performance data showing species-bridging comparability
Documentation of resource allocation and program management (resourcing plan, critical-path Gantt or equivalent) showing capability to execute the proposed parallelized 3-month Stage-1 deliverables
strongest_objection: The supplied evidence is only a consensus guideline (MISEV2023) and contains no program-specific CMC, assay validation, batch comparability, formulation compatibility, or GLP-like biodistribution data. Therefore the recommendation to declare the program insufficiently characterized (or to proceed on the proposed 3-month, parallelized Stage-1 execution) is not supported by the supplied evidence set — the guideline cannot substitute for the concrete, program-level deliverables required to de-risk identity/potency and lot-to-lot comparability.
